column1:
Prevention of DM
through Religious
Leaders
column4:
1. Training of 100 Imams in 100 upazilas
2. Diabetes Screening Corners in 100 Mosques
3. Development of a Khutbah in both Bangla and Arabic
and instruction to all the registered 3 lacs mosques to use
this Khutbah during Friday sermon
4. 30,000 people screened for DM and HTN in diabetes
corners

column1:
Preconception Care to
prevent the onset of GDM
and future DM through
Religious Leaders (Kazis)
column4:
1. Training of 400 Marriage Registrars/Kazis in 8 divisions
(50/ each division)
2. Starting of 54 Preconception Care Centers in 54 BADAS
Centers
3. 3,000 women of childbearing age given preconception
care package

column1:
Development of Diabetes
Care BADAS Guideline
column4: 1. 1,000 doctors throughout the country were trained

1. Development of software-based clinical management of
diabetic patients
2. 1,000 GPs were trained

1. Two Guidelines on COVID-19 and DM- one for
Physicians (English) and another one for non-health
professionals (Bangla)
2. Online courses for physicians and general people which
enrolled 20,000 people
3. Two online surveys and one hospital-based survey
completed
4. Published two papers on COVID-19 and Diabetes

column1:
Manpower training on
diabetes and related
NCDs
column4:
1. 600 Government health professionals including doctors,
nurses and SACMO were trained
2. 200 medical and nursing students given training

column1:
Research Related to
Diabetes and other NCDs
column4:
1. A nationwide survey to screen people with unknown
diabetes and related risk factors
2. A nationwide survey to assess the prevalence of GDM
and related risk factors in Bangladesh
3. A nationwide survey to assess the cardio-metabolic risk
factors (DM, HTN) among the young adult population in
Bangladesh
